data.title: 五和 · 上条宿舍的湿毛巾极限害羞
data.description: 上条当麻乱糟糟的单身公寓榻榻米上，五和双手毕恭毕敬捧着冒着热气的特制擦拭毛巾，依照天草式长辈的“贤妻指导”服侍当麻，脸蛋早已涨成红番茄，羞得抬不起头。
data.location: cozy cluttered student apartment tatami room with tea table and sliding shoji screens
data.action: kneeling formally on tatami presenting a steaming rolled hand towel with both hands, face completely crimson with shy trembling smile
data.lighting: 客厅吸顶灯与毛巾升腾的温热白雾
data.promptProse: Itsuwa kneels formally on the tatami offering a hot steaming towel with trembling hands, blushing furiously from ear to ear in bashful devotion.
data.animaCaption: Delicate steam rises from the fresh towel as her purple eyes flutter with overwhelming shyness.
